normative_extracts.quote: The content-visibility property controls whether or not an element renders its contents at all, skipping layout and painting for offscreen subtrees.
Windowing renders only the small subset of rows visible within the scroll viewport plus a small overscan buffer, keeping DOM node count O(viewport).

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Caps live DOM nodes to O(viewport_height / row_height) by recycling or mounting only visible rows + overscan inside a full-height spacer container.

production_failures.symptom: White blank flashes appear when user flings scrollbar rapidly on mobile
production_failures.root_cause: Zero overscan rows were rendered outside the viewport, and compositor scrolling outran main-thread JS scroll listeners.
production_failures.mitigation: Render a 3-5 row overscan buffer above and below the viewport and position rows with GPU-composited transform: translateY().

production_failures.symptom: Ctrl+F (Cmd+F) browser find and screen readers cannot locate offscreen items
production_failures.root_cause: Virtualization unmounted offscreen DOM nodes completely, making them invisible to native page search and ARIA table navigation.
production_failures.mitigation: Set aria-rowcount / aria-rowindex for assistive tech, or use CSS content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size for moderate lists (< 2,000 items).
